name: Richul Oh, M.D.
tagline: Ophthalmologist · Retina & vitreous · Medical AI and clinical big data
bio: I practice ophthalmology with a subspecialty in retina and vitreous at Seoul National University Hospital. My research uses ultra-widefield fundus imaging, optical coherence tomography, and clinical big data to develop medical AI methods.
